metadata.description: Two-way sync between a local Markdown mirror and an Atlassian Confluence space, via the Atlassian MCP server.

plugins.name: confluence-sync
plugins.description: Keeps a local Markdown tree under confluence/<SPACE>/ in two-way sync with a Confluence space: walks the tree, compares each file's frontmatter watermark against the live remote page, and skips, pushes, pulls, or surfaces a conflict per page.
